tools.name: mailshake_get_account
tools.description: Show the signed-in Mailshake user and team. Also the cheapest call to check the API key. Mailshake: POST /me.

tools.name: mailshake_list_team_members
tools.description: List the users on the team, for assigning leads. Mailshake: POST /team/list-members.

tools.name: mailshake_list_senders
tools.description: List the sender accounts (the mailboxes that send campaign emails). Mailshake: POST /senders/list.

tools.name: mailshake_list_campaigns
tools.description: List the team's campaigns with their IDs and status. Start here to find a campaignID. Costs 10 quota units per call. Mailshake: POST /campaigns/list.

tools.name: mailshake_get_campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign and its message sequence. Mailshake: POST /campaigns/get.

tools.name: mailshake_list_recipients
tools.description: List the recipients of one campaign. Filter by state (for example opened, clicked, replied, wasSent, bounced, paused, hasProblems); set negateAction to exclude that state. Costs 10 quota units per call. Mailshake: POST /recipients/list.

tools.name: mailshake_list_leads
tools.description: List the team's leads: recipients who may be interested. Filter by campaign, status (for example open) or the teammate the lead is assigned to. Costs 1 quota unit per call. Mailshake: POST /leads/list.

tools.name: mailshake_list_sent_messages
tools.description: List the most recent emails sent, with the recipient and the message text as plain text. Costs 1 quota unit per call. Mailshake: POST /activity/sent.

tools.name: mailshake_list_replies
tools.description: List the most recent replies, with the reply text as plain text. Use replyType reply for real answers; bounce, out-of-office, unsubscribe and delay-notification are the other kinds. Costs 10 quota units per call. Mailshake: POST /activity/replies.

tools.name: mailshake_list_opens
tools.description: List the most recent email opens. Costs 2 quota units per call. Mailshake: POST /activity/opens.

tools.name: mailshake_list_clicks
tools.description: List the most recent clicks on tracked links. Costs 3 quota units per call. Mailshake: POST /activity/clicks.

tools.name: mailshake_list_created_leads
tools.description: List the most recently created leads (from Lead Catcher rules or manual conversions). Costs 5 quota units per call. Mailshake: POST /activity/created-leads.

tools.name: mailshake_list_lead_status_changes
tools.description: List the most recently updated leads (opened, won, lost or ignored). Costs 5 quota units per call. Mailshake: POST /activity/lead-status-changes.

tools.name: mailshake_pause_campaign
tools.description: Stop all sending for a campaign now. Emails already in a batch are not stopped. Undo with mailshake_unpause_campaign. Mailshake: POST /campaigns/pause.

tools.name: mailshake_unpause_campaign
tools.description: Resume sending for a paused campaign. The sending calendar reschedules its pending emails. Mailshake: POST /campaigns/unpause.

tools.name: mailshake_pause_recipient
tools.description: Stop all sending to one recipient in a campaign. Undo with mailshake_unpause_recipient. Mailshake: POST /recipients/pause.

tools.name: mailshake_unpause_recipient
tools.description: Resume sending to one paused recipient in a campaign. Mailshake: POST /recipients/unpause.

tools.name: mailshake_close_lead
tools.description: Mark a lead as won (status closed, the default) or as lost (status lost). Mailshake: POST /leads/close.

tools.name: mailshake_ignore_lead
tools.description: Mark a lead as not worth pursuing (ignored). Undo with mailshake_reopen_lead. Mailshake: POST /leads/ignore.

tools.name: mailshake_reopen_lead
tools.description: Make a closed or ignored lead open again for review. Mailshake: POST /leads/reopen.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mailshake_get_account, mailshake_list_team_members, mailshake_list_senders, mailshake_list_campaigns, mailshake_get_campaign, mailshake_list_recipients, mailshake_list_leads, mailshake_list_sent_messages, mailshake_list_replies, mailshake_list_opens, mailshake_list_clicks, mailshake_list_created_leads, mailshake_list_lead_status_changes, mailshake_reopen_lead · Private data: mailshake_get_account · Public sink: mailshake_get_account, mailshake_list_team_members, mailshake_list_senders, mailshake_list_campaigns, mailshake_get_campaign, mailshake_list_recipients, mailshake_list_leads, mailshake_list_sent_messages, mailshake_list_replies, mailshake_list_opens, mailshake_list_clicks, mailshake_list_created_leads, mailshake_list_lead_status_changes, mailshake_pause_campaign, mailshake_unpause_campaign, mailshake_pause_recipient, mailshake_unpause_recipient, mailshake_close_lead, mailshake_ignore_lead, mailshake_reopen_lead.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
